_comment: One feed, five flavors. A flavor is a WoW client generation; the addon folder name differs per client, so one release unpacks into the right folder for each. Copy this when your source publishes an archive per client. thread_url is blank here: point it at the page you read, and it works the same whether or not that page needs a login, because the reader uses a browser you signed in to.
